correctness.rationale: Exact line equations over Z[zeta_8] are proved to specialize to 28 distinct lines in every odd characteristic; restrictions to the quartic identify their tangent roles including characteristic-three contact collision. Exact all-3276-triple field norms exhibit only 3,5,17 as odd prime divisors, certifying the exhaustive prime range, while p=3,5,17 finite-field pair incidences are exhaustive and explained by Hermitian polarity, the F5 punctured-grid collinearities, and the F17 diagonal symmetry. A separate p=7 control reproduces the 2023 complex generic profile. The bundled standard-library script checks full norm frequencies, refinements, all 378 pairs and triple types. The universal proof is not extrapolation from a finite list of primes.

value.rationale: A complete natural arithmetic-specialization invariant is determined for a distinguished 28-line configuration already studied in plane-quartic geometry. Every odd prime is covered, not a motivated but arbitrary finite cutoff. The two distinct previously unspecified triple-point formation mechanisms at p=5 and 17 and the p=3 Hermitian transition explain why characteristic zero is an inadequate proxy for the modular incidence lattice. The exact bad-prime support from integral concurrence norms is an intrinsic structural boundary with potential use in positive-characteristic arrangement geometry. This is nonroutine and not only an isolated numerical check.
